parts.text: In this experiment, you are to investigate reflection from a plane mirror. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 4.1. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Draw a straight line EF across the ray trace sheet, about 10 cm from the top of the sheet.

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Draw a normal GH to line EF so that point G is approximately at the centre of line EF .

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Draw a line GJ at an angle of incidence i = 30° to the normal as shown in Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Place the ray trace sheet on the pin board. Place the mirror so that it stands along the line EF .

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Push a pin P 1 into the surface at a point on GJ close to the mirror. Label this point A .

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Push another pin P 2 into the surface on GJ some distance from the mirror. Label this point B .

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) View the images of the pins P 1 and P 2 from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 4.1. Push two pins P 3 and P 4 into the surface between your eye and the mirror so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 appear exactly in line.

parts.label: h
parts.text: (h) Mark the positions of pins P 3 and P 4 on the ray trace sheet with letters C and D . Remove the pins and the mirror. Using a rule, draw a line joining C and D , and continue this line to meet the line EF .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure the angle of reflection r 1 between lines GH and CD . r 1 = .......................................................... [1]

parts.label: j
parts.text: (j) Draw a line E'GF' such that the angle θ between this line and the line EGF is 10°. (See Fig. 4.1). Place the mirror so that it stands along the line E'F' .

parts.label: k
parts.text: (k) Push the pins P 1 and P 2 into the ray trace sheet at the same points A and B used previously.

parts.label: m
parts.text: (m) Mark the positions of pins P 3 and P 4 on the ray trace sheet with letters C' and D' . Remove the pins and the mirror. Using a rule, draw a line joining C' and D' , and continue this line to meet the line E'F' .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the angle α through which the reflected ray has moved. α = ...............................................................

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate the difference between 2 θ and α . difference between 2 θ and α = .......................................................... [2]
